release_blocking_gates.title: Transactional local commit before success feedback
requirements: Append JSONL event and fsync where supported
Write individual record JSON
Update session checkpoint or manifest atomically
Only then emit success beep and RECORD_SAVED state
Failure injection proves no false success acknowledgement

release_blocking_gates.title: Simulated and physical evidence separation
requirements: Simulator receipts use simulator truth class
Physical hardware claims require UNO/HX711/load-cell evidence
Packaging build does not imply hardware pass
UI smoke test does not imply production deployment

release_blocking_gates.title: Native Windows executable
requirements: Build on a Windows runner or Windows host
Produce a real PE executable
Run version/self-test command
Record OS, architecture, Python, dependency, command, exit code and SHA-256
Include executable or zipped one-folder distribution in final release

release_blocking_gates.title: Native Debian package
requirements: Build on Debian or a declared compatible Debian environment
Produce a valid .deb package
Inspect package metadata
Install in an isolated test environment where feasible
Run version/self-test command
Record environment, command, result and SHA-256

release_blocking_gates.title: Chat and Google Drive delivery
requirements: Create final full-repo ZIP
Create checksums
Expose chat download links
Find or create one Drive project folder without duplicating moved folders
Upload repo ZIP, Windows artifact, Debian artifact, checksums and validation report
Verify Drive metadata after upload
If connector upload fails, report exact failure and preserve chat downloads

debian.preferred: dpkg-deb or a deterministic Debian packaging toolchain
debian.must_build_on: Debian or explicitly declared Debian-compatible environment

prohibited: Cross-compiling with unsupported PyInstaller workflow and calling it native
Claiming launch success without executing a smoke command

security_hardening: No credentials or access tokens in repo, logs, example configs or release artifacts
All remote adapters disabled by default
Local data root permission preflight before run start
Barcode, operator note and imported spreadsheet cells treated as untrusted input
Formula injection protection in CSV/XLSX exports
Path traversal prevention for session and export names
Bounded serial-line length and malformed-message rejection
Crash recovery from JSONL and checkpoint
Secret and generated-binary scan before release

constraints: Remote sync never blocks the weighing loop
Spreadsheet update failure becomes pending-sync receipt
Serial reads occur off the UI thread
Report compilation cannot mutate authoritative events
Long-running exports expose progress and cancellation

required_release_artifacts: Windows executable or Windows one-folder ZIP containing the executable
Drive delivery receipt or explicit connector-failure report
non_claims: No physical hardware pass without actual board/load-cell evidence
No Metrc integration without provider receipts
No Windows package pass without Windows execution
No Debian package pass without package inspection and smoke evidence
No Drive upload success without returned Drive metadata
